chapter.title: ACE Station Keeping
chapter.para: This walkthrough constructs the shipped Ex_LibrationPointStationKeeping_ESM.script through GUI forms. Seven target sequences maintain an illustrative orbit about Sun-Earth L1 by targeting rotating-frame VX at each Y = 0 crossing. This simple example is not a fuel-efficient operational stationkeeping design. The shipped script explicitly notes that its delta-V is larger than an operational design.

listitem.para: Choose File, New. Rename DefaultSC to ACE. Select UTCGregorian, epoch 09 Dec 2005 13:00:00.000, EarthMJ2000Eq and Cartesian. Set X, Y, Z, VX, VY and VZ to -528665.5773210001, -1325445.164527, -525969.843578, 0.240435056, -0.068342458, 0.0315715361. Retain DryMass 850, Cd 2.2, Cr 1.8, DragArea 15 and SRPArea 1. Apply and Close.

Rename DefaultProp to EarthSunMoon. Set MinStep 0, MaxStep 40000 and MaxStepAttempts 40000. Keep RungeKutta89, InitialStepSize 60, Accuracy 9.999999999999999e-12 and StopIfAccuracyIsViolated true. Open the associated force model, clear PrimaryBodies and set PointMasses to Sun, Earth, Luna in that order. Keep CentralBody Earth, Drag None, SRP Off and ErrorControl RSSStep.

Under Calculated Points add Barycenter DefaultBC with BodyNames Earth, Luna. Add LibrationPoint ESL1 with Primary Sun, Secondary Earth and Point L1. The barycenter is retained from the reference; ESL1 itself uses Sun and Earth directly.

Add CoordinateSystem EarthSunL1CS with Origin ESL1 and Axes ObjectReferenced. Under Advanced, Axes, set Primary Sun, Secondary Earth, XAxis R, YAxis blank and ZAxis N. Click OK and Apply. Add EarthSunRotCS with Origin Earth and the same axis settings.

Add ImpulsiveBurn MCC. Set CoordinateSystem to EarthSunRotCS, all three elements to zero and DecrementMass false. This is a rotating-frame Cartesian burn: Element1 is the rotating X direction. Do not replace it with the third component of a Local VNB burn. Add DifferentialCorrector DefaultDC with its defaults.

Rename DefaultOrbitView to L1View, include ACE, Earth and Sun, and set CoordinateSystem and ViewUpCoordinateSystem to EarthSunL1CS. Use ESL1 for ViewPointReference and ViewDirection, offset [0 0 540000], ViewUpAxis X and SolverIterations Current.

Create EarthSunRotView including ACE, Earth, Luna and Sun. Set CoordinateSystem and ViewUpCoordinateSystem to EarthSunRotCS. Use Earth as camera reference and direction, offset [-3000000 -1500000 1000000], ViewUpAxis Z and SolverIterations Current. These viewer choices do not change the numerical mission.

section.title: Configure the Mission Sequence
section.para: Delete the initial Propagate. Append For1 with Index I, Start 1, Step 1 and End 7. Apply and Close. Inside For1 append Target1 with Solver DefaultDC, SolveMode Solve and ExitMode DiscardAndContinue.
Append these four commands inside Target1, configuring their typed fields before Apply and closing the panel before adding the next command.

listitem.para: Vary with Solver DefaultDC, Variable MCC.Element1, Initial value MCC.Element1, Perturbation 1e-5, Lower -0.1, Upper 0.1 and MaxStep 0.001.

Propagate with EarthSunMoon and ACE, Single step unchecked, Stop parameter ACE.EarthSunL1CS.Y, Stop value 0, and Stop tolerance 1e-5. Enter the zero explicitly; changing the stop parameter does not replace the template's old value.
Achieve with DefaultDC: Goal ACE.EarthSunL1CS.VX, Value 0 and Tolerance 1e-5.

section.para: There is no 12000-second coast after Target1 in the reference sequence. Do not add one when comparing with the shipped example. Earlier walkthroughs used a different burn frame, step limits, a different target exit mode and an additional coast; those produce a different simulation.

section.title: Run and Compare
section.para: Save, Run and verify that all seven targets converge. Use Latest and Fit to inspect the retained arcs. Reopen the saved mission and verify the MCC frame, Vary initial expression, zero Y stop and DiscardAndContinue. Compare the mission with the unchanged shipped example. Extra reports or total-delta-V calculations may be added as a separate diagnostic exercise after preserving this baseline; they are not prerequisites for this example.
